item.g:title: Set of 3 men's cuff hoop earrings - 3 multicolored cuffs
item.g:description: Set of 3 handmade men's cuff hoop earrings, crafted from woven 925 silver, in a bold masculine hoop design that does not require pierced ears. This is a piece of jewelry that can be worn by any man who prefers a rock or hipster style of dressing, but it also suits any occasion where you want to be noticed for your unique taste! Additionally, a very original set of earrings to gift to men you want to be remembered by forever wearing them. The price is for a set of three earrings No pierced ear required Available in various colors Weight: 9.0gr Width: 12mm Height: 9mm These earrings are hypoallergenic and do not tarnish, as they are made from rhodium-plated 925 silver A unique handmade piece of jewelry made with attention to detail and a perfect gift idea for men. It is especially durable and reliable, as it undergoes a special plating process that gives it an amazing finish. At the same time, this makes it immune to factors that could affect the silver. Each piece of jewelry is delivered placed separately in an elegant gift box. Inside the package, you will also find a paper bag for each set. The men's jewelry collection to which this item belongs consists of notable accessories for men, with original and inventive designs, in line with the latest and boldest trends in modern fashion. It targets dynamic, trendy, and modern men who choose to stand out and express themselves through their dressing, without losing their true identity. Wearing these creations, they will certainly not go unnoticed. Our designs are inspired by professions, travels, history, religion, nature, and inner search. Special emphasis is given to music and the arts. The "Emmanuela - handcrafted for you" jewelry is so fashionable and unique that you can wear it on any occasion. They can even be worn at the beach, because these pieces match amazingly well with tattoos, while their construction is so durable that they are not affected by sea water or the sun!

item.g:title: Wedding crowns "spirals" - White satin
item.g:description: Entirely handmade and Greek wedding crowns with spirals, crafted from 925 silver. A classic motif serves as the inspiration for this wonderful design reminiscent of the Ionic order! For every pair of silver wedding crowns you choose, we gift you 2 matching lapel pins (boutonnieres) which, according to tradition, are worn by the groom and the best man during the ceremony. Weight: 65.00gr The crowns undergo special treatment to maintain their shine and prevent tarnishing over time. They are tied optionally with satin ribbon or organza in white or ivory shades and placed in an elegant and luxurious white box. In the Orthodox wedding, the crowns are royal symbols referring to the new kingdom inaugurated by the newlywed couple: their home! That is why the newlyweds are crowned with "glory and honor" with the wish to rule their kingdom with wisdom and love! The price is for one pair

item.g:title: Wedding crowns "lemon tree" - White satin
item.g:description: Entirely handmade and Greek wedding crowns crafted from forged 925 silver. A design reminiscent of a real crown made of flowers! The crowns are decorated with hammered leaves and pearls that give them greater volume and brilliance as well as a sense of liveliness! For every pair of silver wedding crowns you choose, we gift you 2 matching boutonnières which, according to tradition, are worn by the groom and the best man during the ceremony. Weight: 70.00gr The crowns undergo special treatment to maintain their shine and prevent tarnishing over time. They are tied optionally with satin ribbon or organza in white or ivory shades and placed in an elegant and luxurious white box. In the Orthodox wedding, the crowns are royal symbols and refer to the new kingdom inaugurated by the newlywed couple: their home! That is why the newlyweds are crowned with "glory and honor" with the wish to rule their kingdom with wisdom and love! The price is for one pair
